تبحي (form I)
# تَبَحِّي (tabaḥḥī) /ta.baħ.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of بَحَّ (baḥḥa)
# تُبَحِّي (tubaḥḥī) /tu.baħ.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of بَحَّ (baḥḥa)
